summary: Procure ephemeral analyst sandboxes for Staccato Analytics (VPC + SCIM + BYOK)
description: Request to purchase and onboard 50 ephemeral 'analyst sandbox' licenses from Staccato Analytics for a 3-month pilot. The customer-facing product requires a private VPC deployment (eu-west), SCIM provisioning via Okta groups, and customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) for encryption at rest. Legal requires a signed DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence before we can transfer any production data. Procurement should evaluate invoice cadence options (monthly vs net30 annual) and confirm EMEA tax handling.
impact: Teams: Data Platform and Analytics. Use case: short-term pilot for cross-functional analysts ingesting internal telemetry and customer usage datasets. If delayed, pilot start shifts ~4 weeks and blocks analytics roadmap milestone. Not a critical production outage but high priority due to dependent stakeholder cadence.
business_justification: Pilot will validate Staccato's SQL-on-vector capability for large embeddings-based analytics; expected to reduce weekly analyst turnaround by ~30% if successful. Budget is approved under FIN-AN-23 for Q2 pilots, but procurement needs PO creation and contract routing.
requirements: 1) Private VPC instance in eu-west with no public egress. 2) SCIM provisioning integration with Okta: group sync for 'analytics-sandbox-*' and lifecycle deprovisioning. 3) BYOK via AWS CloudHSM; vendor must accept customer-managed key materials. 4) Per-seat audit logs delivered to our Splunk intake (HTTPS forwarder). 5) DPA and SOC2 evidence attached to contract. 6) 50 ephemeral seats with automation to expire seats after 30 days of inactivity.
steps_to_provision: 1) Procurement: obtain vendor quote and standard contract with DPA clause. 2) Security: perform security questionnaire and verify SOC2 + BYOK support. 3) Infra: provision VPC peering and firewall rules, open egress to vendor IPs. 4) Auth: configure SCIM connector in Okta and test group sync on staging. 5) Billing: confirm invoicing cadence and map cost center FIN-AN-23. 6) Ops: validate Splunk log ingestion and test key rotation flow.
acceptance_criteria: VPC instance provisioned in eu-west with no public ingress
SCIM group sync creates and deprovisions seats reliably in staging
BYOK successfully integrated and keys never exported by vendor
Splunk shows ingestion of per-seat audit events
Signed DPA and SOC2 evidence present in contract repository
Invoice terms confirmed and PO issued against FIN-AN-23
